risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (219.5), imminent NFP event, and negative macro score (-7) create severe near-term headwinds despite 90-day earnings distance.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure (price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, 15x volume spike) with congressional buy signal and fear-zone contrarian opportunity justify swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought conditions (RSI 70+, StochRSI, BB squeeze), MACD bearish divergence, crisis-level VIX (219.5), inverted yield curve, zero fundamental conviction, and stale congressional data (98-114 days old) create unacceptable near-term pullback and macro headwind risk.
